entries.value: More than one ATOAvatarOptimizer component found on this avatar; exactly one is allowed.
Remove all but one ATOAvatarOptimizer component from the avatar hierarchy.
ATOAvatarOptimizer must be placed on the GameObject that holds the VRCAvatarDescriptor.
Move the ATOAvatarOptimizer component to the avatar root (the object with the VRCAvatarDescriptor).
